gioiHanDaBiet: Chi phu 279 bang ma web cu co model; con khoang 286 bang trong DB chua co mat trong so nay.
KHONG phat hien duoc ung vien CrossLink khi bang da co khoa so huu. Cac cot nhu CompanyIDOrg, PaymentCompanyId, PromoteCompanyIds tro toi cong ty KHAC va chi nguoi duyet moi phan biet duoc.

Khong phan biet duoc Global voi PerTenant: ca hai deu bieu hien la 'khong co khoa cong ty'. Mac dinh gan PerTenant, nguoi duyet phai nang len Global neu du lieu giong nhau o moi hang va co noi o vat ly xac dinh (AD-6).
